reasons: The verdict comes first: a Failed mark and word, a plain sentence, the recorded cause (the provider reported an invalid address) and a concrete next step. Every time shows UTC, the product terms are correct, and the page promises no retry and gives no retry time. The cause shown matches a recorded bounce reason, so no cause is invented.
